title: サクラチヨノオー登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The time has finally come for Sakura Chiyono O to take on the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As such, we're attending an information session for Umamusume making their debuts soon, but a certain someone seems a bit flustered…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-o-oh my gosh. I-it's finally here… U-uh…
choice_data_list: Want to take some deep breaths?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: S-sure! Let's do it together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Inhale… Inhale…
choice_data_list: Don't just inhale! You have to exhale too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Exhale! Exhale! Exhaaale!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine! Probably. For sure! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O is stiff with nerves as we walk into the room where the information session will be held.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Th-the pressure in here… is overwhelming!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Why, hello, Chiyono O. Come take a seat. This chair's available.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan! I'm looking forward to racing with you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan of the Mejiro family… She's a school year above Sakura Chiyono O, but it seems they'll be debuting at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter what school year they're in, all the Umamusume here today will be running peers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are quite a number of Umamusume in here, and I heard there will be some students transferring in at a later date too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing as Sakura Chiyono O's nerves are getting the better of her, I do my best to observe her potential rivals. But then…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Trainer! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O suddenly pokes me in the side and hands me something.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A notebook I prepared in advance. I, um, thought it would be of some help to you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I open the notebook she handed me and am immediately struck by the walls of handwritten text in it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You can keep that if you'd like. I've already memorized everything written in it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: For example, look at page one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Bamboo is the hot-blooded head of the disciplinary committee. True to her temperament, she excels at sprints and mile races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: However, due to the fragility of her toenails, she has already decided to run on dirt instead of turf to start with.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Creek is a stayer who prefers long distances. It's also worth noting that she is very good at caring for others.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: From that, we can discern that she is incredibly perceptive, able to spot people's strengths and weaknesses with ease.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Anyway, that's what I've been able to dig up! If you flip through to the second half, I've listed up some information on Ardan and Yaeno too!
choice_data_list: You've certainly put a lot of work into this!
You've certainly put a lot of work into this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Preparation and review are the foundation for readiness, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Besides, I'll need to put a lot of work in if I want to win the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no race more important to Sakura Chiyono O than the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's because of Maruzensky, an Umamusume Sakura Chiyono O greatly admires.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Known as the Beast thanks to her overwhelming strength, she's the one who gave Sakura Chiyono O this dream.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Good luck in the real Japanese Derby. Do what I could only dream of doing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You would entrust your dreams… to me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And I… I swear, I will win the Japanese Derby! I will become the number one runner!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So when… when that happens, when I'm stronger… Will you run with me again?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …You can only compete in the Japanese Derby once in your life, and only one Umamusume can come out of it the victor.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But I'm going to do it, Trainer. For her sake…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! Without question!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the information session, we decide to do some quick training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Trainer… Can I please… take a water break?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Sakura Chiyono O is taking a break, I look over the notebook she gave me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are a few potential rivals she'll have to contend with if she's aiming for the Derby…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First of all, there's Yaeno Muteki. I hear that like Sakura Chiyono O, she's skilled at medium-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to these notes, her grandfather is the master of the Kongo Yaegaki style of martial arts. Having trained diligently, she can pull off terrifying bursts of speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan, whom Sakura Chiyono O was speaking to earlier, may run in the Derby as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ardan is the younger sister of Mejiro Ramonu, the first Umamusume to ever win the Triple Tiara. She is also very talented, and expectations for her are high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she decides against running the Tiara tour, there's no doubt she'll be a powerful rival for Sakura Chiyono O in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm fully charged! I'm ready to run another—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O suddenly freezes, her eyes locked on something in the distance. I turn to see what she's staring at, and when I do…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see none other than Maruzensky, along with the Triple Crown champion, Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's unusual to see Maruzensky near the track. I was sure she said she was going to forgo running in the Twinkle Series for a while…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyooo! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-oh, uh! I-I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… hehe… Oh my gosh… Maruzen just cheered me on…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: W-well, she's the dream I'm chasing, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: She's the devastatingly powerful Hot Rod who breaks boundaries wherever she goes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The first time I saw her run, I knew I wanted to be like her—to someday stand as her equal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Regardless of how mediocre an Umamusume I am, this is the one dream I never want to give up on…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Although considering how lofty a dream it is, I may not be able to actually reach it.
choice_data_list: Then I'll be your stepping stool.
Then I'll be your stepping stool.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: If you use me to take a step up, you might be able to reach your dream.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Hahaha! I couldn't possibly use you as a stepping stool. That would be rude!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But that did help me come up with a new proverb!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: From now on, we'll be working closely together, so…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "I'm the pot, and you're the ladle"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A pot and a ladle have different jobs, but you need both to make a delicious chanko hot pot!
choice_data_list: You're the pot, and I'm the ladle…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's it! Now let's get cooking, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, my days of training with Sakura Chiyono O begin.
